core_obligations: Assert (S1) and the first half of (S2) (proof lines 4676-4681): (S1) holds by the cited lemma, and the first part of (S2) follows from (S1) as in the standard argument.

Prove the second half of (S2) (proof lines 4681-4712): take the two diagrams lying over the square with k[epsilon]; using the versal object find morphisms b : xi -> y and b' : xi -> y' making the square commute; the pushforwards of xi along the two composites with the projections of k[epsilon] both equal x_epsilon, so by the bijectivity condition the two ring maps R -> k[epsilon] coincide, whence the two maps R -> A x_k k[epsilon] coincide; consequently y and y' are both pushforwards of xi along that map, giving the unique compatible isomorphism y -> y'.

Finiteness of the tangent space (proof lines 4714-4716): the tangent space of the predeformation category has the same dimension as that of the functor represented by R, which is finite dimensional by the explicit computation for prorepresentable functors.
proof_roadmap: Import (S1) and the first half of (S2) from the theory of versal objects.
Reduce the second half of (S2) to the bijectivity condition by pushing the versal object along the two composites.
Read off finiteness of the tangent space from prorepresentability.
